summary: #clmooc What do you do the day after democracy died? Knowing they all lied Shutting down justice letting evil walk amongst us Then you remember there is still November And prey for our nation's ability to survive' white fragility a celebration of hope over hate
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
#clmooc
What do you do the day after democracy died?
Knowing they all lied
Shutting down justice
letting evil walk
amongst us
Then you remember
there is still November
And prey for
our nation's
ability
to survive'
white fragility
a celebration of
hope over hate
